pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on opening secondary positions within 3.0 ATR of an existing losing ticket to eliminate compounding falling knife exposure.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero-entry during 15-minute high-impact volatility compression bands; require volume delta confirmation and order book imbalance > 65% prior to execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Aggressively lock in gains when floating profit reaches $15.00 via trailing micro-steps, preventing profitable runs from collapsing back to breakeven or minor losses.
